# react-tiny-state

> A super simple React state management library (npm: `@jswork/react-tiny-state`) built on a global singleton store + `useSyncExternalStore` — no `Provider`, no `Context`. It provides modular stores with `state` / `getters` / `actions` / `watch`, nested-path read/write (`nx.$get` / `nx.$set`), and global methods (`nx.$call`, `nx.$use`). Its only runtime dependency is `fast-deep-equal`.

The package has no default export. Importing it is a side effect that attaches the `$`-prefixed APIs onto the global `nx` (from `@jswork/next`): `nx.$defineStore` declares a store module and `nx.$registerStores` batch-registers modules composed via Vite's `import.meta.glob` (module keys are camelized, e.g. `member/profile.ts` -> `memberProfile`). `nx.$get` / `nx.$set` / `nx.$call` / `nx.$use` read, write (firing matching `watch` watchers), invoke actions, and consume state inside components; `nx.$resetStore` clears everything.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Full getting-started guide covering store modules, composing stores, loading stores in the app entry, and the complete API reference (`$defineStore`, `$registerStores`, `$get`, `$set`, `$call`, `$use`)

## Source

- [src/index.ts](src/index.ts): Core implementation — attaches `$defineStore` / `$registerStores` / `$get` / `$set` / `$call` / `$use` / `$resetStore` onto the global `nx`, backed by a module-level singleton store + `useSyncExternalStore`
- [src/types.ts](src/types.ts): Type declarations for `StoreModuleDef`, `Watcher`, `ActionFn`, and `GetterFn`
- [src/utils.ts](src/utils.ts): Inlined utility functions (`camelize`, `resolveModuleNameFromPath`) used for module naming from file paths

## Examples

- [Tests](__tests__/index.spec.ts): Unit tests for the side-effect global API (`$defineStore`, `$registerStores`, `$get` / `$set` / `$call`, watchers, getters) and the `camelize` / `resolveModuleNameFromPath` utils

## Optional

- [package.json](package.json): Package metadata, scripts (`dev` / `build` / `test` / `release`), and dependencies
- [gulpfile.js](gulpfile.js): Build pipeline (esbuild + gulp-typescript) producing `dist` bundles
- [tsconfig.json](tsconfig.json): TypeScript configuration for `src`
- [jest.config.js](jest.config.js): Test runner configuration
- [docs/vite.config.ts](docs/vite.config.ts): Vite config for the docs playground app
